title: Ulyana and the Summer
author: Jonah Pemberton
blurb: Quentin Okonkwo, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
